outcome: Early initiation of breastfeeding within 1 hour of birth
cohort: 1700 mothers of children aged less than 24 months in Saudi Arabia
finding: Early initiation of breastfeeding within 1 hour of birth was associated with mode of delivery, maternal knowledge, receipt of breastfeeding information, region of residence, and maternal education level.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was associated with early initiation of breastfeeding.
